title: RXO Executive Named a Finalist in 2026 Stevie® Awards for Women in Business
summary: The award is recognizing achievements in the digital transformation (Women-Led Initiative) category.
body_markdown:
**CHARLOTTE, N.C. – September 23, 2026** –[RXO](http://www.rxo.com/) (NYSE: RXO), a leading provider of asset-light transportation solutions, announced today that Chief Technology Officer Alyssa Myers was named a finalist by the Stevie® Awards for Women on Business for 2026 in the Achievement in Digital Transformation (Woman-Led Initiative) category.


The Stevie Awards for Women in Business honor the achievements of women executives, entrepreneurs, employees, and the companies they run– worldwide. The Stevie Award has been hailed as the world’s premier business award.


As chief technology officer, Alyssa oversees RXO’s comprehensive technology strategy and advances the company’s core technology including leading RXO’s successful transition into the era of agentic AI. In 2025, she led one of the freight industry’s largest technology integrations following RXO’s acquisition of Coyote Logistics. By combining the best capabilities from both companies, she rapidly unified the two organizations while reducing technical debt and laying a strong foundation for future growth.


“Alyssa’s vision and execution have advanced what’s possible in freight technology,” said Drew Wilkerson, chairman and chief executive officer of RXO. “Under her leadership, we’ve modernized how freight moves and raised the standard for efficiency across our ecosystem. This recognition is well deserved, highlighting Alyssa’s achievements and reinforcing RXO’s position as an industry leader.”


Maggie Miller, president of the Stevie Awards, said, “As the Stevie Awards for Women in Business marks its 23rd year, we continue to be impressed by the remarkable accomplishments represented among the nominations. It is especially rewarding to see the significance a Stevie Award holds for women and the recognition it brings to their achievements, careers, and organizations. We congratulate all of this year’s finalists and look forward to revealing the Gold, Silver, and Bronze Stevie Award placements on November 16.”


Final winner placements will be announced at an awards ceremony in New York City. To view more details about the Stevie Awards for Women in Business and the full list of winners across categories, visit[http://Women.StevieAwards.com](https://women.stevieawards.com/awards/sawib-winners/2026/stevie-award-winners/) .


**About RXO**


RXO (NYSE: RXO) is a leading provider of asset-light transportation solutions. RXO offers tech-enabled truck brokerage services together with complementary solutions including managed transportation and last mile delivery. The company combines massive capacity and cutting-edge technology to move freight efficiently through supply chains across North America. The company is headquartered in Charlotte, N.C.
